name: Bludit content HTTP API
description: Token-gated HTTP interface for reading pages, tags and categories and for administrator-authorized page, category, user, settings, image and file operations.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Bludit JSON stores and global runtime objects
metadata.overlap: Independent Bludit extension or subsystem; compose with the CMS host rather than treating internal lifecycle methods as separate assets.
metadata.deployment_warning: API token grants read access; write access additionally requires an enabled administrator authentication token. Configure allowed origins and protect both credentials.
